notes: Run of 2026-11-22. Two Standard stories queued; one names buildings — a supervisors' hearing on replacing the Hall of Justice — and it is declined. The other names no address.

findings.description: Supervisors held a hearing on the Hall of Justice's condition and on moving the courthouse to a Mid-Market site.

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Mall of Justice? Supes eye moving courthouse downtown,” 21 November 2026

publish.note: Declined: fails the ten-year test. A committee hearing floating sites is talk, not an event at 850 Bryant; nothing was decided, and 1455 Market and 50 UN Plaza appear only as candidate sites. A decision to vacate, sell or replace the building would be the entry.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 850 BRYANT ST → parcel 3759042; sf-parcels has blklot 3759042 active, 425–425 07TH; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use. The assessor files the parcel as 425 07TH ST.
